count_python_files_and_lines.purpose: Counts all Python files in a specified directory and its subdirectories, then calculates their total line count.

calculate_md5_hash_of_readme.purpose: Calculate the MD5 hash of the README.md file.

calculate_pycache_size.purpose: Calculate the total disk space occupied by all __pycache__ folders within a specified directory.

list_active_network_adapters.purpose: Lists all active network adapters with their IP addresses.
